key.name: hidden
key.description: When true the character is hidden and all of its timers and animations are stopped.

key.name: paused
key.description: When true the character freezes where it is: no roaming, no idle animation, no pointer tracking.

key.name: quiet-mode
key.description: When true the character stays at its home position, does not roam and has no idle bobbing. It still reacts to clicks and still looks at the pointer.

key.name: focus-mode
key.description: When true the character stays at home with its back to you, completely still, and ignores the pointer. Clicking it still gets a short reaction.

key.name: roaming
key.description: Allow the character to walk away from its home position now and then and return.

key.name: pointer-look
key.description: When the pointer is near, the character turns toward it.

key.name: character-height
key.description: Height of the character on screen in logical pixels.

key.name: home-corner
key.description: Corner of the primary monitor's work area where the character lives.

key.name: summon-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that makes the character come to the pointer. It also shows it if it is hidden or paused.

key.name: character-name
key.description: Optional name the user gives the character. The empty string (the default) means no name has been assigned and none is shown. Written by the preferences window; at most 32 characters.

key.name: backpack-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the backpack. It works even while the character is hidden.

key.name: pocket-expiry-hours
key.description: Hours an item stays in the pocket before it disappears. Items already in the pocket keep the lifetime they had when they were added.
